name: Isometric Dumbbell Row Hold
instructions: Hinge forward with a dumbbell in each hand, back flat.
Row both dumbbells to your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Hold the top position 10-20 seconds, keeping the torso still.
Lower with control and rest before the next hold.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: An intermediate dumbbell pull-pattern exercise for the lats and upper back. Isometric Dumbbell Row Hold strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
